subject: Request: Hosted API rate card + pricing parity vs OpenAI/Anthropic/Together/AWS
messages:
From: Anna Lee <anna@signalpath.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API baseline + competitor pricing match

Hi Vivek,

We're finalizing our vendor shortlist for hosted inference and I wanted to get Redwood's baseline rate card and any flexibility you have to match incumbents. Quick context: SignalPath will be evaluating a product search assistant (RAG + LLM) and expect initial usage of ~20M generation tokens/month and ~50k embedding requests/month, ramping to ~60M tokens in Q4.

Competitors we've received sealed pricing from in the RFP:
- OpenAI: conversational model equivalent listed at $0.0035 / 1k tokens (generation) + embeddings at $0.002 / 1k
- Anthropic: list price for their Claude-small at ~$0.004 / 1k tokens, embeddings similar
- Together / other inference providers: occasionally lower for heavy batch embeddings but higher for live low-latency traffic
- AWS Bedrock: higher per-token but with volume discounts at commit levels

Can you: (1) share Redwood's hosted API rate card for generation + embeddings, (2) tell me whether you can match or beat the OpenAI/Anthropic numbers above, and (3) outline any credits or commit-based discounts you offer? We need a written line-item comparison for procurement by EOD next Wednesday.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if that helps.

Best,
Anna
Anna Lee
Head of Product
SignalPath

--

Folks — forwarding SignalPath's request. Key asks: line-item hosted generation + embeddings, and an explicit competitor parity proposal that we can send to procurement. They called out OpenAI and Anthropic numbers (see below).

Quick suggested options to consider for response:
- Option A (aggressive): 20% off public hosted rates for first 6 months + $25k trial credit with a 12-month minimum commitment (~$120k ARR), SLA included.
- Option B (balanced): 12% off hosted token rates + $15k credit, 6-month commit trial ($60k), embeddings priced at $0.0015 / 1k.
- Option C (no-commit): standard list + 30k credit + 60-day proof-of-concept (no commit).

Requesting input from pricing/finance: what flexibility do we have here? Are there constraints around revenue recognition for credits (Priyom) or bundling a quantized model variant (Karthik)?

Thanks — want to get a clean external note back to Anna by EOD Wed.

— Marissa
Sr Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Marissa / team — saw the request, here are constraints and a recommended counter: 

Constraints:
- We can’t give permanent parity to public OpenAI list prices except under explicit committed spend.
- Credits > $20k require finance approval and will be amortized per accounting rules.

Recommended counter (approvable):
- Token generation (hosted API): match competitive effective price via a 12% discount off our public hosted rates for 12 months. If they commit to $90k minimum ARR (12-mo), we can increase to 18% for first 6 months.
- Embeddings: propose $0.0015 / 1k for first 6 months (competitively priced vs published embeddings rates).
- Startup trial credit: $15k applied to first invoice.
- Operational sweeteners: included basic SLA (99.5 P99) and 2-week ramp support from Solutions Engineering; custom quantized model variant available as an opt-in at additional setup fee (helps reduce token cost for sustained heavy traffic).

If legal requires contract language to lock in rates for the initial term, finance will need the deal_id and forecasted recognition schedule. I can greenlight the 12% core discount + $15k credit; 18% is contingent on a signed 12-mo $90k commit before start date.

-Karthik
Director, Pricing & Commercials

- Legal needs to review the SLA wording for downgrade/fallback clauses; finance will sign off once legal confirms.

Proceed with the external offer; mark the deal in SF/HubSpot with the forecast and revenue recognition note.

Subject: Redwood proposal: SignalPath hosted API rate card + parity offer

Anna / procurement — thanks for the RFP details and for the quick turnaround request. Per our internal review, here's a concise proposal you can share with procurement. I'll follow up with a short call to walk through the spreadsheet.

Summary offer (valid for 14 days):
- Token generation (hosted API): 12% discount off Redwood public hosted generation rates for the first 12 months. If SignalPath executes a 12-month agreement with a minimum committed spend of $90,000, we will increase the discount to 18% for months 1–6.
- Embeddings: $0.0015 / 1k requests for the first 6 months (then revert to standard tiered pricing).
- Trial credit: one-time $15,000 credit applied to the first invoice (amortized over the initial term).
- SLA & support: 99.5% P99 latency SLA, two-week ramp support from Solutions Engineering included.
- Optional: custom quantized model variant for heavy inference patterns (one-time setup fee; helps reduce per-token CPU/GPU cost).

Attachments: redwood_ratecard_signalpath_q3.pdf (line-item rates), signalpath_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (proposed milestone & signatures).

Next steps:
1) Procurement: confirm contract start date and whether procurement needs a PO prior to signature.
2) If you want the enhanced 18% introductory discount, sign the 12-month commitment (min $90k) and return countersigned MPA by Jul 30.
3) We'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Solutions Engineering after countersignature.

If you'd like, we can also produce a short two-column comparison (Redwood vs OpenAI/Anthropic/Together/AWS) that highlights effective landed cost per 1M tokens at your projected volumes. I can send that as an addendum by tomorrow morning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
